newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt detains Swiss woman on bigamy charges.
newsitem.headline: Egypt detains Swiss woman on bigamy charges.

text.p: Egyptian police have detained in the Red Sea resort of Sharm el-Sheikh a Swiss woman on charges of bigamy, the state-owned Al-Akhbar newspaper said on Wednesday.
It said the 40-year-old woman had met her first husband, Egyptian driver Mohammed Dia el-Din, in Switzerland. She later met her second husband, butcher Adel Mahmoud in the Red Sea town of Dahab.
The Swiss embassy in Cairo confirmed that the woman had been detained for bigamy but would not give any more details.
Bigamy is illegal in Switzerland for both men and women. Islam, the official religion of Egypt, allows men to marry up to four wives but does not offer the same alternative to women.
